problem_statement: A transport-complete Anthropic SSE response containing only reasoning blocks and a max_tokens stop was correctly rejected before Contract Runtime input, but the durable attempt remained open and a wrapper was ultimately classified as generic transport failure.
invariants: Exact provider response bytes and their existing hashes remain immutable.
No credential lookup, provider client creation, HTTP request, network call, model call, paid call, or Full Short execution occurs in this task.
A downstream parser, adapter, final-artifact, contract, or business failure is never defaulted to transport.
A captured complete response is handled by deterministic local replay only; it is never network-redispatched.
Ambiguous external completion remains fail-closed and cannot restart or redispatch.
Authority mutates only after a validated local stage receipt.
Logical stage counts remain distinct from physical dispatch counts and all physical dispatches count against hard caps.

selected_design.failure_provenance: Recursively classify nested typed failures; map output-limit evidence to output_truncation and remove the ModelRoutesExhaustedError transport default.
selected_design.durable_transition: Close a captured 2xx pre-contract final-artifact rejection with a content-free typed receipt that requires provider-protocol capture and explicitly permits absent Contract Runtime input.
selected_design.replay: Validate Anthropic terminal SSE state and re-enter the same adapter projection locally from immutable captured bytes.

forbidden_changes: fallback enablement beyond separately authorized existing routes
modification of the consumed authorization, signed approval, nonce, ledger, or captures
